in_marathi.name: Kalyani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalyani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Kalyani means 'Goddess of prosperity'. It is derived from the word 'Kalyas', meaning 'auspicious'. This name is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the Hindu goddess of wealth and good fortune. Kalyani is a popular name among Hindus, and is believed to bring prosperity, happiness, and good luck to those who bear it.
